build_command: automatic DigitalOcean Python buildpack; custom build command must remain blank
storage: atomic local JSON by default; optional single-writer DigitalOcean Spaces mirror
private_config_warning: The private packages contain unencrypted production credentials and saved private state. Keep them private.
shuffle_snapshot_behavior: All ranks 1-15 publish atomically; successful snapshots receive independent standings/movement sequences; failures retain the last verified snapshot; placement events expire at an exact server timestamp.
public_experience: V25 no-refresh in-place standings through a dedicated 5-second conditional local feed, explicit 45-second server movement events, larger placement badges, value-change highlighting, and server-synchronized countdowns.
admin_experience: Backend-driven provider timing plus standings/movement sequence diagnostics and the last 20 process-local placement events.
countdown_clock: Server-synchronized fractional UTC time; countdowns recalculate from authoritative end timestamps on every render.
snapshot_ordering: Process runtime id plus monotonic public snapshot sequence; stale same-runtime responses are ignored.
empiredrop_refresh_policy: 90-second minimum; longer provider race.cache_duration remains authoritative
live_standings_behavior: Browser reads only verified local snapshots; provider APIs are never called from the browser. Older same-runtime provider sequences are ignored.
